+from pathlib import Path
+from collections import Counter
+import json,re,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+P=json.loads((Path(__file__).parent/'PROTOCOL.json').read_text())
+def verify(folder,form='normal'):
+    folder=Path(folder);w=P['witnesses'].get(form,{})
+    assert form in ['normal','restored'] or form in P['witnesses']
+    rc=int((folder/'exit.txt').read_text());log=(folder/'output.log').read_text()
+    assert not re.search(r'^e: |Compilation error|Unresolved reference',log,re.M)
+    assert (rc!=0)==bool(w)
+    assert ('BUILD FAILED' if w else 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL') in log
+    assert re.findall(r'^> Task (\S+) FAILED$',log,re.M)==([':rules-engine:test'] if w else [])
+    files=list((folder/'junit').rglob('TEST-*.xml'));classes={c['class'] for c in P['cases'].values()}
+    assert len(files)==len(classes)==2
+    observed=[];failures=[]
+    for path in files:
+        root=ET.fromstring(path.read_bytes());cls=root.get('name');assert cls in classes
+        assert str(path.relative_to(folder/'junit'))=='rules-engine/build/test-results/test/TEST-'+cls+'.xml'
+        rows=root.findall('testcase');expected=[(id,c) for id,c in P['cases'].items() if c['class']==cls]
+        assert [int(root.get(k)) for k in ['tests','failures','errors','skipped']]==[len(expected),sum(id in w for id,c in expected),0,0]
+        for row in rows:
+            key=(row.get('classname'),row.get('name'));observed.append(key)
+            matches=[(id,c) for id,c in expected if key==(c['class'],c['name'])];assert len(matches)==1
+            id,c=matches[0];fs=row.findall('failure');assert row.find('error') is None and row.find('skipped') is None
+            if id in w:
+                assert len(fs)==1;f=fs[0];assert f.get('type')=='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError'
+                assert w[id]['message'] in f.get('message','') and w[id]['message'] in (f.text or '')
+                frames=re.findall(re.escape(c['file'])+r':(\d+)',f.text or '')
+                assert frames and int(frames[0])==w[id]['line']
+                failures.append({'id':id,'line':int(frames[0]),'message':f.get('message')})
+            else:assert not fs
+    assert Counter(observed)==Counter((c['class'],c['name']) for c in P['cases'].values())
+    return {'form':form,'rows':16,'failures':failures,'passing_controls':16-len(w),'skips':0}

+from pathlib import Path
+import tempfile,copy,json,xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
+from audit import P,verify
+count=0
+with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
+    d=Path(tmp)
+    def fixture(form):
+        for p in d.rglob('TEST-*.xml'):p.unlink()
+        w=P['witnesses'].get(form,{})
+        (d/'exit.txt').write_text('1' if w else '0')
+        (d/'output.log').write_text('> Task :rules-engine:test FAILED\nBUILD FAILED\n' if w else 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL\n')
+        paths=[]
+        for cls in sorted({c['class'] for c in P['cases'].values()}):
+            cs=[(id,c) for id,c in P['cases'].items() if c['class']==cls]
+            r=ET.Element('testsuite',name=cls,tests=str(len(cs)),failures=str(sum(id in w for id,c in cs)),errors='0',skipped='0')
+            for id,c in cs:
+                t=ET.SubElement(r,'testcase',name=c['name'],classname=cls)
+                if id in w:
+                    msg='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError: '+w[id]['message']
+                    ET.SubElement(t,'failure',type='org.opentest4j.AssertionFailedError',message=msg).text=msg+'\n at fixture('+c['file']+':'+str(w[id]['line'])+')'
+            p=d/'junit/rules-engine/build/test-results/test'/('TEST-'+cls+'.xml');p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(ET.tostring(r));paths.append(p)
+        return paths
+    for form in ['normal','restored',*P['witnesses']]:
+        fixture(form);verify(d,form)
+    for label in ['missing-report','missing-case','duplicate','wrong-class','skip','wrong-count','missing-witness','wrong-type','wrong-message','wrong-frame','unrelated-failure','compile-error']:
+        paths=fixture('drop-power');p=paths[0];r=ET.fromstring(p.read_bytes());f=r.find('.//failure')
+        if label=='missing-report':p.unlink()
+        elif label=='compile-error':(d/'output.log').write_text('e: Unresolved reference\n> Task :rules-engine:compileTestKotlin FAILED\nBUILD FAILED')
+        else:
+            if label=='missing-case':r.remove(r[0])
+            elif label=='duplicate':r.append(copy.deepcopy(r[0]))
+            elif label=='wrong-class':r[0].set('classname','wrong')
+            elif label=='skip':ET.SubElement(r[0],'skipped')
+            elif label=='wrong-count':r.set('tests','0')
+            elif label=='missing-witness':next(t for t in r if t.find('failure') is not None).remove(f)
+            elif label=='wrong-type':f.set('type','CompilerException')
+            elif label=='wrong-message':f.set('message','wrong')
+            elif label=='wrong-frame':f.text=f.get('message')+'\n at fixture(BoltBendCostPredicateTest.kt:1)'
+            elif label=='unrelated-failure':ET.SubElement(r[0],'failure')
+            p.write_bytes(ET.tostring(r))
+        try:verify(d,'drop-power')
+        except (AssertionError,ValueError):count+=1
+        else:raise AssertionError('accepted '+label)
+print(json.dumps({'accepted_synthetic_forms':10,'rejected_corruptions':count,'engine_evidence':False}))

+"""Bounded draft forms. Compilation and behavioral witnesses remain mandatory."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import hashlib, json, sys
+
+def sha(data): return hashlib.sha256(data.encode()).hexdigest()
+def replace_once(text, old, new):
+    assert text.count(old) == 1, (old, text.count(old))
+    return text.replace(old, new, 1)
+
+def forms(normal):
+    power = '(projectedState.getPower(entityId) ?: card.baseStats?.basePower ?: 0) >= predicate.min'
+    selector = 'return projectedState.getBattlefieldControlledBy(playerId).any { entityId ->'
+    start = normal.index('    private fun controlsMatchingPermanent(')
+    end = normal.index('\n    /**', start)
+    body = normal[start:end]
+    def local(old, new): return normal[:start] + replace_once(body, old, new) + normal[end:]
+    result = {
+      'drop-power': local(power, 'false'),
+      'exclusive-threshold': local(power, power.replace('>=', '>')),
+      'base-power': local(power, '(card.baseStats?.basePower ?: 0) >= predicate.min'),
+      'owner-battlefield': local(selector, 'return state.getBattlefield(playerId).any { entityId ->'),
+      'ignore-controller': local(selector, 'return state.getBattlefield().any { entityId ->'),
+      'wrong-amount': replace_once(normal, 'if (controls) source.amount else 0', 'if (controls) source.amount - 1 else 0'),
+      'drop-red': replace_once(normal, 'effectiveCost = reduceGenericCost(effectiveCost, totalReduction)',
+         'effectiveCost = reduceGenericCost(effectiveCost, totalReduction)\n        if (totalReduction > 0) effectiveCost = ManaCost(effectiveCost.symbols.filterNot { Color.RED in it.colors })'),
+      'base-type': local('matchesBattlefieldPredicate(entityId, cardDef, predicate, projectedState)',
+         'if (predicate == CardPredicate.IsCreature) cardDef.typeLine.isCreature else matchesBattlefieldPredicate(entityId, cardDef, predicate, projectedState)'),
+    }
+    assert len(set(result.values())) == 8 and normal not in result.values()
+    return result
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    normal = Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text()
+    output = Path(sys.argv[2]); output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    manifest = {'state':'DRAFT_FORMS_NOT_COMPILED', 'normal_sha256':sha(normal), 'forms':{}}
+    for name, content in forms(normal).items():
+        (output / (name + '.kt')).write_text(content)
+        manifest['forms'][name] = {'sha256':sha(content), 'bytes':len(content.encode())}
+    (output / 'FORMS.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\n')
+    print(json.dumps(manifest))

+"""Compile and observe unchanged production; preserve original reports and bytes."""
+from pathlib import Path
+import os,json,subprocess,hashlib,re,traceback
+import sys
+sys.path.insert(0,str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
+from audit import P,verify
+from mutants import forms
+ROOT=Path.cwd();HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;OUT=ROOT/P['evidence']
+sha=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
+git=lambda *a:subprocess.check_output(['git',*a],text=True).strip()
+def save(p,b):p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);p.write_bytes(b)
+def js(p,v):save(p,(json.dumps(v,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
+def bind(label):
+    source=os.environ['SOURCE'];assert git('rev-parse',source+'^{tree}')==os.environ['SOURCE_TREE']
+    assert git('rev-parse',source+'^')==P['base'] and git('rev-parse','HEAD^')==source
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',source,'HEAD')==os.environ['WORKFLOW']
+    assert git('diff','--name-only',P['base'],source).splitlines()==sorted(P['source_delta'])
+    assert git('rev-parse','refs/remotes/origin/main')==P['main']
+    assert not git('status','--porcelain','--untracked-files=no')
+    trees={}
+    for path in P['unchanged_trees']:
+        before=git('rev-parse',P['base']+':'+path);after=git('rev-parse',source+':'+path)
+        assert before==after,path;trees[path]=after
+    js(OUT/label/'UNCHANGED_TREES.json',trees)
+    for path,digest in P['bindings'].items():
+        b=(ROOT/path).read_bytes();assert sha(b)==digest,path;save(OUT/label/'source'/path,b)
+    for path,digest in P['git_bindings'].items():
+        assert git('hash-object',path)==digest,path;save(OUT/label/'source'/path,(ROOT/path).read_bytes())
+    save(OUT/label/'TRACKED.diff',subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--']))
+    if label=='initial':
+        for f in HERE.iterdir():
+            if f.is_file():save(OUT/'protocol'/f.name,f.read_bytes())
+        save(OUT/'WORKFLOW.yml',(ROOT/os.environ['WORKFLOW']).read_bytes())
+        b=dict(source=source,tree=os.environ['SOURCE_TREE'],validation=git('rev-parse','HEAD'),validation_tree=git('rev-parse','HEAD^{tree}'),workflow=os.environ['WORKFLOW'],workflow_blob=git('hash-object',os.environ['WORKFLOW']),run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],attempt=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']),run_number=int(os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_NUMBER']))
+        assert b['attempt']==b['run_number']==1;js(OUT/'BINDING.json',b)
+def stage(name,recipe,form="normal"):
+    folder=OUT/name;folder.mkdir(parents=True)
+    for f in ROOT.glob('**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml'):
+        if OUT not in f.parents:f.unlink()
+    with (folder/'output.log').open('wb') as log:
+        rc=subprocess.run(['just','--working-directory',str(ROOT),'--justfile',str(HERE/'validation.just'),recipe],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if k not in ['KOTEST_INCLUDE_PATTERN','UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS']}).returncode
+    (folder/'exit.txt').write_text(str(rc)+'\n')
+    for f in ROOT.glob('**/build/test-results/test/TEST-*.xml'):
+        if OUT not in f.parents:save(folder/'junit'/f.relative_to(ROOT),f.read_bytes())
+    if recipe=='compile':
+        log=(folder/'output.log').read_text();assert rc==0 and 'BUILD SUCCESSFUL' in log
+        assert not re.search(r'^e: |Compilation error|Unresolved reference|^> Task .* FAILED$',log,re.M)
+        assert not list((folder/'junit').rglob('TEST-*.xml'))
+    else:js(folder/'SUMMARY.json',verify(folder,form))
+def main():
+    OUT.mkdir();bind('initial')
+    receipt=json.loads((ROOT/P['reuse_receipt']/'RECEIPT.json').read_text());classification=json.loads((ROOT/P['reuse_receipt']/'CLASSIFICATION.json').read_text())
+    assert receipt['run']==classification['run']==41035962802
+    assert classification['compiled_forms']==9 and classification['normal_cases']==16 and classification['negative_witnesses']==36 and classification['negative_passing_controls']==76
+    save(OUT/'REUSED_RECEIPT.json',(ROOT/P['reuse_receipt']/'RECEIPT.json').read_bytes())
+    save(OUT/'REUSED_CLASSIFICATION.json',(ROOT/P['reuse_receipt']/'CLASSIFICATION.json').read_bytes())
+    controls=subprocess.check_output(['python3',str(HERE/'check_audit.py')]);save(OUT/'AUDITOR_CONTROLS.json',controls)
+    path=ROOT/P['cost_path'];normal=path.read_text();allforms={'normal':normal,**forms(normal)}
+    assert sha(normal.encode())==P['forms']['normal_sha256']
+    for name,content in allforms.items():
+        if name!='normal':assert sha(content.encode())==P['forms']['forms'][name]['sha256']
+        save(OUT/'forms'/(name+'.kt'),content.encode())
+    try:
+        path.write_text(allforms['base-type']);stage('compile-base-type','compile')
+        stage('negative-base-type','tests','base-type')
+        path.write_text(normal);stage('compile-restored','compile');stage('restored','tests','restored')
+    finally:
+        path.write_text(normal)
+        assert sha(path.read_bytes())==P['forms']['normal_sha256']
+    bind('final')
+    js(OUT/'RESULT.json',{'state':'MISSING_EARLY_GATES_COMPLETE_ORIGINAL_RECEIVING_PENDING','feature_admitted':False,'card_admitted':False,'remaining_mandatory_gates':P['remaining_mandatory_gates']})
+if __name__=='__main__':
+    try:main()
+    except Exception:
+        OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True);(OUT/'FAILURE.txt').write_text(traceback.format_exc());raise
+    finally:
+        try:bind('final')
+        finally:
+            OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
+            js(OUT/'MANIFEST.json',{str(f.relative_to(OUT)):sha(f.read_bytes()) for f in sorted(OUT.rglob('*')) if f.is_file() and f.name!='MANIFEST.json'})

+name: Manual Bolt Bend missing early gates R2
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [validation/manual-bolt-bend-early-missing-r2-20261030]
+    paths: ['.github/workflows/manual-bolt-bend-early-missing-r2-20261030.yml']
+permissions: {contents: read}
+concurrency:
+  group: manual-transmission-engine-qualification
+  cancel-in-progress: false
+env:
+  SOURCE: 5b76957211ef14d5c8f436811a8311774d40cd4a
+  SOURCE_TREE: 13023c7f62fc6a43edc89b79419391828421115d
+  WORKFLOW: .github/workflows/manual-bolt-bend-early-missing-r2-20261030.yml
+  RECORD: experiments/manual-transmission/research/bolt-bend-early-missing-r2-20261030
+  GRADLE_OPTS: -Dorg.gradle.daemon=false
+  GRADLE_LOCK_SLOTS: '1'
+jobs:
+  verify:
+    if: github.run_number == 1 && github.run_attempt == 1
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 120
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+        with: {persist-credentials: false, fetch-depth: 0}
+      - uses: actions/setup-java@v4
+        with: {distribution: temurin, java-version: '21'}
+      - uses: gradle/actions/setup-gradle@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with: {node-version: '22', cache: npm, cache-dependency-path: web-client/package-lock.json}
+      - name: Install approved locked recipe runner
+        run: |
+          sudo apt-get update
+          sudo apt-get install -y just
+          command -v flock
+          mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/argentum"
+      - name: Compile and execute only missing base-type and restored gates
+        run: flock -x -w 1800 "$HOME/.cache/argentum/manual-transmission.lock" python3 "$RECORD/run.py"
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: manual-bolt-bend-early-missing-r2-${{ github.run_id }}
+          path: manual-bolt-bend-early-missing-r2-evidence/
+          include-hidden-files: true
+          if-no-files-found: error
+          retention-days: 90
